result: The team set out to build a fish from dominoes. Omar wanted the start at the top of the tail, but Sofia moved it to the tail tip, so every line headed right. Hana redrew the outline. The turn came when Priya spotted a V at the notch, too tight for the fall to turn through. Hana smoothed both edges into curves running from START to the nose. Priya then judged the tail fins would point back against the fall, and dropped them. Sofia laid the top edge, Leo the belly, and Jack the join at the back of the tail. But nobody could confirm START was standing. Sam spotted a domino sitting off its line, and Grace called a halt: "Hold the push, everyone." With little time left, the team had a fish on paper and a belly that would only make an arc. The result: 0 of 53 fell. Blind judges guessed a blank canvas.
